services.name: Glider Test Pilot
services.desc: Step into the role of Glider Test Pilot at The Hangar! Students discover the principles of flight and four forces that act on the movement of living things and constructed objects in the air by building and testing gliders. Scientific discovery and manipulation of variables will take place to get hands-on experience

services.name: Theory Of Flight
services.desc: Through discussion and touring through the museum with a knowledgeable guide, students learn how an aircraft flies. They study forces of flight, Bernoulli’s Principle, Newton’s Laws of Motion, and the control surfaces of aircraft.
